name: Geckoboard
description: Access accurate, up-to-date business metrics from Geckoboard directly in Claude. Query data from Zendesk, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Aircall, Google Analytics, and more without exporting records or calculating metrics by hand. With the Geckoboard connector, Claude can investigate changes, draft reports, trigger workflows, and build data-powered tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Geckoboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Geckoboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.geckoboard.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Geckoboard MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Geckoboard provides these MCP tools: get_data_list, get_metric, list_connections, list_data_lists, list_field_values, list_metrics, list_scope_values, query_data_lists, and query_metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Geckoboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Geckoboard in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Geckoboard requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Geckoboard is developed by Geckoboard. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
